finding.title: Buffer overflow in scanf
finding.assumptions: The input is expected to be an integer, but no validation is performed on the input size.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code calls scanf("%d", &number) where number is a local int variable of size sizeof(int). The %d conversion reads an integer value; if the input value exceeds the representable range of int, the conversion is implementation‑defined or may set errno, but it does not write beyond the 4‑byte buffer holding number. There is no array or larger buffer involved that could be overrun. Therefore the alleged buffer overflow cannot occur.
